column3: Close to the Greek; NKJV adds “peoples” to “all.”
NKJV has “with you” and “while,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “among you” and “as.”
NKJV has “While,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “As.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV has “hearts” for the singular “heart.”
NKJV has “when he saw,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “because he saw.”
Close to the Greek; “glory” is rendered “praise.”
NKJV has “does not believe,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “does not keep them.”
